data.narrative:
Noveon Magnetics is a Series C-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Scott Dunn and Peter Afiuny that has raised $365M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable set of 9 private peers (Hadrian, Agile Robots, Nimble Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, and three others) and 1 public comparable (ticker 277810.KQ), all operating in the Robotics & Manufacturing sector.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression method uses the $365M raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical for Series C progression, yielding $620M. The peer-median method examines three same-sector, same-stage comparables: Hadrian at $1.6B, Agile Robots at $1.0B, and Nimble Robotics at $1.0B, producing a median multiple of $1.0B and a range of $1.0B–$1.6B.

The triangulated analysis across both methods supports a valuation range of $527M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $810M. The spread reflects material uncertainty between the conservative stage-progression approach and the higher peer-median benchmark. Key dependencies include the representativeness of the three-peer median sample and whether Noveon's capital efficiency and market position align with Hadrian (upper range) or the $1.0B tier. Additional visibility on revenue, burn rate, and customer concentration would narrow this range.
